description: This file defines a static class `StreamInstruments` which contains various metrics instruments related to stream processing in the Orleans runtime. It includes counters for producers and consumers added/removed, total counts, gauges for persistent stream pulling agents, cache sizes, and methods to register observation functions for gauges.

classes.name: StreamInstruments
classes.description: Contains static methods and fields for instrumentation metrics related to stream activities in Orleans.

methods.name: RegisterPersistentStreamPullingAgentsObserve
methods.description: Registers an observer function for the persistent stream pulling agents gauge.

methods.name: RegisterPersistentStreamPubSubCacheSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observer function for the persistent stream pub-sub cache size gauge.
